name: Aider
tagline: AI pair programming in your terminal with Git repo map integration and multi-file editing.
author: Paul Gauthier
description: Aider lets you pair program with frontier LLMs in your terminal. It builds a concise tree-sitter map of your entire Git codebase and automatically commits changes with descriptive Git commit messages.

name: Magentic-One (AutoGen)
tagline: Generalist multi-agent system from Microsoft Research solving complex multi-step digital tasks.
author: Microsoft Research
description: Magentic-One is a multi-agent team directed by an Orchestrator agent. It routes tasks to specialized WebSurfer, FileSurfer, and Coder agents to execute web research, coding, and file handling.

name: AWS CDK Infrastructure Synthesizer
tagline: Converts architecture diagrams and natural language requirements into declarative AWS CDK v2 TypeScript/Python.
author: CloudOps Automation
description: Synthesizes production-ready AWS CDK constructs with built-in KMS encryption, least-privilege IAM policies, VPC isolation, and CloudWatch metrics. Eliminates imperative Boto3 script drift.

name: Browser-Use
tagline: Connect AI agents directly to the browser for automated web navigation, form filling, and data scraping.
author: browser-use
description: Browser-Use gives LLMs sight and control over a real Chromium browser. It converts interactive web elements into accessible coordinate systems and handles multi-tab navigation, authentication, and dynamic web applications.

quickstart.command: pip install browser-use playwright && playwright install

name: Contract & Lease Risk Auditor
tagline: Instant plain-English legal risk auditor identifying hidden liability, indemnification, and auto-renewals.
author: aiagent.org Core
description: Specialized agent prompt pipeline that parses lengthy PDF contracts, compares provisions against consumer protection standards, and highlights predatory termination penalties in under 10 seconds.

quickstart.command: Open https://aiagent.org/articles/2026-11-03/tame-long-pdfs-contracts-ai/ to run in Gemini / NotebookLM

name: CrewAI Enterprise Squad
tagline: Role-playing multi-agent team with hierarchical supervisor task delegation and memory.
author: CrewAI Inc.
description: A production-tested CrewAI team orchestrating Researcher, Analyst, and Writer agents. Supports sequential and hierarchical workflows with persistent memory and tool execution guardrails.

name: GPT-Researcher
tagline: Autonomous agent for in-depth online research, citation aggregation, and synthesis reports.
author: Tavily AI
description: GPT Researcher produces comprehensive, cited, multi-page analytical reports by scraping over 20 web sources in parallel, cross-verifying claims, and assembling structured outlines.

name: 7-Minute Inbox Zero Triage Agent
tagline: Triage 50+ unread emails, extract urgent action items, and draft replies in your exact voice.
author: aiagent.org Core
description: Classifies incoming email by urgency (Urgent, Need Input, Low Priority, Newsletters), generates 1-sentence decision summaries, and prepares context-aware reply drafts ready for 1-click sending.

name: Kubernetes SRE Incident Triage Agent
tagline: Autonomous Kubernetes diagnostics agent that parses CrashLoopBackOff logs, pod events, and OOM issues.
author: CloudOps Automation
description: Monitors Kubernetes alerts, runs investigative kubectl commands via Model Context Protocol (MCP), checks memory/CPU limits, identifies bad container config, and drafts incident postmortems.

name: LangGraph Supervisor Swarm
tagline: Stateful cyclic graph agent team with human-in-the-loop pause, resume, and checkpointing.
author: LangChain
description: Production architecture for multi-agent coordination using LangGraph. Features cyclic state updates, conditional branch routing, persistent Postgres checkpoints, and approval interrupts.

name: Fridge-to-Table Meal & Grocery Agent
tagline: Snap a photo of your fridge and generate a 5-day dinner menu with exact missing ingredient grocery lists.
author: aiagent.org Core
description: Analyzes raw photo uploads of your refrigerator shelves, categorizes perishable items by expiry urgency, plans meals around on-hand ingredients, and exports a shopping checklist organized by supermarket aisle.

name: OpenHands (formerly OpenDevin)
tagline: Autonomous AI software engineer that writes code, runs terminal commands, and resolves GitHub issues.
author: All-Hands-AI
description: OpenHands is an open-source platform for autonomous software development. It interacts with the local file system, runs shell commands in Docker sandboxes, browses the web, and solves SWE-bench benchmarks autonomously.

name: Hugging Face Smolagents
tagline: Minimalist, code-first AI agent framework executing actions as Python code blocks.
author: Hugging Face
description: Smolagents writes executable Python code instead of raw JSON tool calls, unlocking expressiveness for loops, conditionals, and data transformations in ~1,000 lines of core framework code.

quickstart.command: pip install smolagents && python -c 'from smolagents import CodeAgent, HfApiModel; CodeAgent(tools=[], model=HfApiModel()).run("Hello!")'

name: Stagehand Web Automation Agent
tagline: AI web browsing framework with natural language act(), extract(), and observe() primitives.
author: Browserbase
description: Built by Browserbase, Stagehand provides 3 intuitive primitives for web automation: page.act() for clicking/typing in plain English, page.extract() for schema-typed extraction, and page.observe() for next-step planning.

name: Vanna.ai SQL Agent
tagline: RAG-driven autonomous Text-to-SQL agent with schema memory and query self-correction.
author: Vanna AI
description: Vanna trains a vector store on your database DDL schemas, documentation, and historical queries to generate high-accuracy SQL, execute it safely, and plot data charts automatically.
